svg.title: Flex distributes along one axis. Grid places into two.
svg.desc: The box model drawn as four nested rectangles from margin down to content, a specificity scoreboard scoring #nav .item a as 1-1-1 against a.item as 0-1-1 with !important crossed out, five flex cards wrapping along a single main axis beside a three-by-two grid whose container decides the placement, and a style-layout-paint-composite pipeline with measured layout times for 5000 items.
svg.text: Flex distributes along one axis. Grid places into two.
set box-sizing: border-box once, globally, and stop
wondering whether width includes the padding.
it does not win an argument, it ends one
FLEX: one axis, the content decides
main axis - it wraps when it runs out
GRID: two axes, the container decides
columns - fixed before any content arrives
changing width re-runs all four. Changing transform
